findings.rationale: Accepted. Decision H: one log contract. No valid gate file: the hook is byte-identical to today, including the record shape (no source field) and no live-state reads that create files (stat only, never mkdir). A valid gate file: the record gains one optional field source (session|subagent). Every other statement in the plan is rewritten to match.
Accepted. require_files may name a file that does not exist yet; the arming check validates path shape and containment only, not existence.

Accepted. Decision I: native subagents are keyed by (session_id, agent_id): depth-0 arms right after the Agent call returns the agent id, writing <session_id>.<agent_id>.gate.json; the SubagentStop hook reads only that key; depth-0 own Stop has no agent_id and never matches a worker file. P0 must prove the Agent result id equals the hook payload agent_id; otherwise the native path is excluded. The arming race (a stop before the file lands) fails open and is stated.

Accepted. Decision J: when --gate-rules is given the rail mints a fresh session id per dispatch (refuses if it cannot), P2 done-condition runs the production hook plus gate-verify.js inside each covered carrier real launch shape with fake claude, and every repo-touching or Claude launch rail is listed as covered or excluded. Double wiring: the gate is idempotent per (session, turn) under the existing counter lock, and P0 (c) decides whether --settings wiring is used at all.

Accepted. Decision L: decision rules become a full partition (a table where every combination of outcomes maps to exactly one verdict, unnamed combinations are NOT-SHIP), m_hand_clean leaves V4 and is measured only in G4, skill_invoked is defined and located, every marker gets a negative and positive trace, G2 primary marker is a positive recorded shape.
